annotations.title: Validate JSON and locate the exact error

description: Use when you need to know whether text is strictly valid JSON, and if not, exactly where it breaks. Strict RFC 8259 check (the same accept/reject as JSON.parse). Returns line, column, the offending line with a caret and whether Mend can repair it. Use mend_repair_json to fix it. Up to 100,000 characters.
name: mend_check_json
title: Validate JSON and locate the exact error
